description: RandSATBench test_ood, N=512 and 1024, alpha 4.0-4.3, ids 1-80 (paired across configs). Tests the promising directions of axes_randsat at sizes where the cavity quantities are informative: small MMW m with the cert scorer, the corrected release_I, fe_bt with bt_cost in the new units, real SP-y at T=0.25, and a WalkSAT proxy. The labels are NOT proven: sat=1 means solved by the best RandSATBench solver (3SAT-best_per_sample.csv), sat=0 means unsolved by all of them. On muletto, test_ood_known_sat.csv was made from that file for N in {512, 1024}.

configs.name: cert
configs.role: BSP 2016 reference: hard SP, certainty scorer, fixed r.

configs.name: dynI
configs.role: Corrected release_I (toward and against groups). Small significant gain at N<=64 in axes_randsat; does it survive at N>=512?

configs.name: rsbm_0.02
configs.role: MMW closure gamma_eff = m ln2 with the cert scorer. Calibration N=512 a=4.2: 1/8 solved vs 0/8 for cert.

configs.name: rsbm_0.10
configs.role: Calibration: 3/8 solved through the BSP path, not a collapse to WalkSAT.

configs.name: rsbm_0.20
configs.role: Upper end of the dose curve, below the m>=0.3 collapse seen in axes_randsat.

configs.name: dynI_rsbm_0.10
configs.role: Interaction of the two positive signals.

configs.name: febt_0.005
configs.role: Gibbs back/dec split in the new units. Calibration: release frequency about 0.45 (cert 0.47).

configs.name: cav_0.25
configs.role: Real SP-y at y=4, outside the tropical regime of T<=0.1.

configs.name: ws_proxy
configs.role: Same flags as rsb_0.50 of axes_randsat. SP collapses to the trivial point and WalkSAT gets the full formula; check numclause in log.txt.
